0.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_000
0.description: A pleasure to see you again. Have you come to meet more Yo-kai? Or perhaps browse my array of special goods?
0.translation_description: È un piacere rivederti. Sei venuto a incontrare altri Yo-kai o magari a dare un’occhiata alla mia selezione di oggetti speciali?

1.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_100_000
1.description: Well if it isn't the master weapons collector <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603>! How may I be of service to you?
1.translation_description: Ecco il più grande collezionista di armi <hex:02081BE905FF0B696E20706572736F6E61FF0B696E20706572736F6E6103>! Come posso esserti utile?

2.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_Q1_000_001
2.description: What would you like to do?

7.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_Q2_000_001
7.description: Which minion will you choose?<hex:02100103>(Yo-kai Medals Required: <hex:022003E80203>, Bag: <hex:022003E80303>)
7.translation_description: Quale minion scegli?<hex:02100103>(Medaglie Yo-kai necessarie: <hex:022003E80203>, inventario: <hex:022003E80303>)

13.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_002
13.description: Why, you've befriended all the Yo-kai I've brought with me! Might it be said that you're quite taken by them? If so, I suggest you come and visit my homeland where you can find more. So many more.
13.translation_description: Come, hai stretto amicizia con tutti gli Yo-kai che ho portato con me! Potrei dire che ne sei proprio conquistato? Se è così, ti consiglio di venire nella mia terra natale: ne troverai molti altri. Molti, molti altri.

14.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_003
14.description: Hmm... You appear to be lacking the required medals. Apologies, but business is business─I'll have to ask you to come back when you've found some more.
14.translation_description: Uhm... a quanto pare ti mancano le medaglie necessarie. Mi dispiace, ma gli affari sono affari: dovrai tornare quando ne avrai raccolte altre.

15.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_100_003
15.description: Yo-kai Medals can be obtained by completing FATEs while equipped with the Yo-kai Watch.
15.translation_description: Puoi ottenere medaglie Yo-kai completando FATE mentre hai equipaggiato l’Orologio Yo-kai.

16.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_200_003
16.description: Yo-kai Medals can be found at FATEs in the following areas:
16.translation_description: Puoi trovare medaglie Yo-kai nei FATE delle seguenti aree:

17.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_300_003
17.description: The Black Shroud: Central, East, South, and North<hex:02100103>La Noscea: Middle, Lower, Western, Upper, and Outer<hex:02100103>Thanalan: Central, Western, Eastern, and Southern<hex:02100103>Coerthas Western Highlands, the Sea of Clouds, the Dravanian Forelands, the Churning Mists, and the Dravanian Hinterlands
17.translation_description: Velo Nero: centrale, orientale, meridionale e settentrionale<hex:02100103>La Noscea: centrale, inferiore, occidentale, superiore ed esterna<hex:02100103>Thanalan: centrale, occidentale, orientale e meridionale<hex:02100103>Altopiani Occidentali di Coerthas, Mar di Nuvole, Avanterra Dravaniana, Nebbie Vorticose ed Entroterra Dravaniano

18.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_400_003
18.description: Azys Lla, the Fringes, the Peaks, the Lochs, the Ruby Sea, Yanxia, the Azim Steppe
18.translation_description: Azys Lla, I Margini, Le Vette, I Laghi, il Mar Rubino, Yanxia e la Steppa di Azim

19.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_004
19.description: Unable to obtain <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> due to insufficient inventory space or having already obtained the item.
19.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103>: spazio insufficiente nell’inventario oppure hai già ottenuto l’oggetto.

20.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_100_004
20.description: Let's get you acquainted, then. Meet your new friend, <hex:02280FFF0A436F6D70616E696F6EE8020103>! I hope you two will get along!
20.translation_description: Allora facciamo le presentazioni. Ecco il tuo nuovo compagno, <hex:02280FFF0A436F6D70616E696F6EE8020103>! Spero che andiate d’accordo!

27.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_005
27.description: I'm afraid you'll have to come back when you acquire some Legendary Medals. I understand obtaining such rare pieces can be difficult, but think of the marvelous rewards you will reap for your efforts! I believe in you!
27.translation_description: Temo che dovrai tornare quando avrai raccolto alcune Medaglie Leggendarie. Capisco che sia difficile ottenere pezzi tanto rari, ma pensa ai meravigliosi premi che ti aspettano! Io credo in te!

28.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_100_005
28.description: Legendary Yo-kai Medals can be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs designated in the Yo-kai Medallium while accompanied by the Yo-kai minion designated on the medal.
28.translation_description: Puoi ottenere le medaglie Yo-kai leggendarie, seppur con scarsa probabilità, partecipando ai FATE indicati nel Yo-kai Medallium; ti basta portare con te il minion Yo-kai indicato sulla medaglia.

29.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_006
29.description: Cannot obtain <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> and <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8030103> due to insufficient inventory space or having already obtained the items.
29.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> e <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8030103>: spazio insufficiente nell’inventario oppure hai già ottenuto entrambi gli oggetti.

30.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_100_006
30.description: Cannot obtain <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> due to insufficient inventory space or having already obtained the item.
30.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103>: spazio insufficiente nell’inventario oppure hai già ottenuto l’oggetto.

31.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_007
31.description: Sword and shield, eh? That's my favorite kind. Here you are, your <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> and <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8030103>.
31.translation_description: Spada e scudo, eh? Sono il mio abbinamento preferito. Ecco qui: <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8020103> e <hex:02280AFF054974656DE8030103>.

32.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_008
32.description: Here you are, your new weapon! Go on, try it out!
32.translation_description: Ecco la tua nuova arma! Provala!

33.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_009
33.description: The number of Legendary Yo-kai Medals required to purchase Yo-kai weapons from Nohi has increased. Participate in FATEs to earn more medals.
33.translation_description: È aumentato il numero di Medaglie Leggendarie Yo-kai necessarie per acquistare le armi Yo-kai da Nohi. Partecipa ai FATE per ottenere altre medaglie.

34.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_031
34.description: Why did I choose to travel to Eorzea? Aside from business, I also came to visit a friend of mine. He's prone to wandering himself, but I always know when he's close by the jangling sound he makes when he walks.
34.translation_description: Perché ho scelto di viaggiare in Eorzea? Per gli affari, certo, ma volevo anche far visita a un mio amico. Anche lui ama vagabondare, ma capisco sempre quando è vicino dal tintinnio che fa mentre cammina.

35.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_032
35.description: Speaking of jangling, I found my coin pouch rather empty after I arrived at the Gold Saucer. I must have dropped some medals from my homeland when I made my way here after searching for Whisper.
35.translation_description: A proposito di tintinnii, dopo essere arrivato al Gold Saucer mi sono accorto che il mio portamonete era quasi vuoto. Dev’essermi caduta qualche medaglia del mio paese mentre venivo qui, dopo aver cercato Whisper.

36.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_033
36.description: Yo-kai Medals can be obtained by completing FATEs while equipped with the Yo-kai Watch.
36.translation_description: Puoi ottenere medaglie Yo-kai completando FATE mentre hai equipaggiato l’Orologio Yo-kai.

37.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_100_033
37.description: Yo-kai Medals can be found at FATEs in the following areas:
37.translation_description: Puoi trovare medaglie Yo-kai nei FATE delle seguenti aree:

38.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_200_033
38.description: The Black Shroud: Central, East, South, and North<hex:02100103>La Noscea: Middle, Lower, Western, Upper, and Outer<hex:02100103>Thanalan: Central, Western, Eastern, and Southern<hex:02100103>Coerthas Western Highlands, the Sea of Clouds, the Dravanian Forelands, the Churning Mists, and the Dravanian Hinterlands
38.translation_description: Velo Nero: centrale, orientale, meridionale e settentrionale<hex:02100103>La Noscea: centrale, inferiore, occidentale, superiore ed esterna<hex:02100103>Thanalan: centrale, occidentale, orientale e meridionale<hex:02100103>Altopiani Occidentali di Coerthas, Mar di Nuvole, Avanterra Dravaniana, Nebbie Vorticose ed Entroterra Dravaniano

39.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_300_033
39.description: Azys Lla, the Fringes, the Peaks, the Lochs, the Ruby Sea, Yanxia, the Azim Steppe
39.translation_description: Azys Lla, I Margini, Le Vette, I Laghi, il Mar Rubino, Yanxia e la Steppa di Azim

40.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_034
40.description: Legendary Medals can be obtained, albeit at a low probability, by participating in FATEs in areas designated in the Yo-kai Medallium while accompanied by the Yo-kai minion designated on the medal.
40.translation_description: Puoi ottenere le Medaglie Leggendarie, seppur con scarsa probabilità, partecipando ai FATE delle aree indicate nel Yo-kai Medallium; porta con te il minion Yo-kai indicato sulla medaglia.

41.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_100_034
41.description: The Yo-kai Medallium can be accessed from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Collection<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> menu or the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Minion Guide<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
41.translation_description: Puoi aprire lo Yo-kai Medallium dal menu <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Collezione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o dalla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Guida Minion<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

42.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_040
42.description: This must be one of the finest exchanges I've had in my travels. I cannot recall the last time an adventurer purchased so many of my weapons. I must say I'm impressed!
42.translation_description: Questo è uno degli scambi più soddisfacenti dei miei viaggi. Non ricordo l’ultima volta che un avventuriero ha acquistato così tante delle mie armi. Devo dire che sono impressionato!

43.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_041
43.description: Ah! It appears my old friend has come to visit me. Well, don't be shy, now! Come on over!
43.translation_description: Ah! A quanto pare è venuto a trovarmi un mio vecchio amico. Non essere timido, avanti! Fatti sotto!

44.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_042
44.description: My apologies, Nohi. I did not want to intrude on what looked like a lively conversation between the two of you.
44.translation_description: Perdonami, Nohi. Non volevo intromettermi in quella che sembrava una conversazione animata tra voi due.

45.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_043
45.description: I'll say. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> just finished acquiring thirteen of my finest weapons! Built <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> quite an arsenal, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> did!
45.translation_description: Eh già! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> ha appena acquistato tredici delle mie armi migliori! Che arsenale si è <hex:020819E905FF0A636F73747275697461FF0A636F7374727569746F03>, <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903>!

46.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_044
46.description: Thirteen!? Well then, allow me to extend my congratulations to you as well.
46.translation_description: Tredici?! Allora permettimi di farti i complimenti anch’io.

47.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_045
47.description: It must have been as tedious as taming a warlion. I can imagine how thrilled you must feel, having obtained long sought-after rewards.
47.translation_description: Dev’essere stata una fatica pari ad addomesticare un leone da guerra. Immagino quanto tu sia entusiasta di aver ottenuto queste ricompense tanto attese.

48.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_100_045
48.description: Yes indeed, tantalizing rewards, for adventurers who throw themselves headfirst into the heat of <hex:021A020203>savage<hex:021A020103> battles. Wouldn't you agree, my minstrel friend?
48.translation_description: Già, ricompense allettanti per chi si getta a capofitto nel vivo delle battaglie <hex:021A020203>sadiche<hex:021A020103>. Non trovi, mio caro amico menestrello?

49.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_200_045
49.description: W─Wait just a moment, we need not discuss such complicated matters now. After all, we are in the midst of celebrating <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> achievement, are we not?
49.translation_description: A-Aspetta un momento, non occorre parlare di questioni così complesse ora. Dopotutto, stiamo festeggiando <hex:020813E905FF07696C2074756FFF07696C2074756F03> traguardo, no?

50.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_046
50.description: Indeed. It's a shame my stay in Eorzea is only temporary. I'm rather curious to see what becomes of your story. Rather, on behalf of my company, I would like to─
50.translation_description: Esatto. È un peccato che la mia permanenza in Eorzea sia solo temporanea. Sono curioso di vedere come si svilupperà la tua storia. Anzi, a nome della mia compagnia, vorrei─

52.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_200_046
52.description: Hey, come back here! I still have some affairs to speak with you about! Hmph. He's always so elusive when I mention the savagery of combat.
52.translation_description: Ehi, torna qui! Ho ancora alcune faccende da discutere con te! Uff, è sempre così sfuggente quando accenno alla brutalità dei combattimenti.

53.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_300_046
53.description: Nevertheless, I was saying perhaps we can go on an adventure on our own somewhere in the future. As friends! Until then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
53.translation_description: Comunque, stavo dicendo che magari un giorno potremmo partire insieme per un’avventura, da amici! Alla prossima, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

57.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_061
57.description: My word! It seems you have claimed one of each of the weapons I have on offer. I cannot imagine how you could possibly carry such an arsenal, let alone actually use it, but I feel congratulations are in order.
57.translation_description: Per tutti i cieli! Sembra che tu abbia ottenuto una copia di tutte le armi che avevo in vendita. Non so come tu possa portarti dietro un simile arsenale, figuriamoci usarlo, ma di sicuro meriti i complimenti.

58.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_062
58.description: And it would appear that another unlikely event is about to unfold, for my friend the minstrel has returned from his wandering.
58.translation_description: E a quanto pare sta per verificarsi un altro evento improbabile: il mio amico menestrello è tornato dal suo vagabondare.

59.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_063
59.description: I do hope I am not interrupting your celebrations...but am I to understand that someone has at last collected a full set of those charming instruments of destruction? A fine achievement, even if only for achievement's sake.
59.translation_description: Spero di non interrompere i festeggiamenti... ma capisco bene che finalmente qualcuno ha raccolto un set completo di quei deliziosi strumenti di distruzione? Una bella impresa, anche solo per il gusto di raggiungere un altro traguardo.

60.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_064
60.description: To have done so in such a short span of time is commendable indeed. Perhaps I should have charged more for them?
60.translation_description: Riuscirci in così poco tempo è davvero lodevole. Forse avrei dovuto chiedere di più?

61.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_065
61.description: If you had, I have no doubt this fine young adventurer would have risen to the challenge regardless.
61.translation_description: Se l’avessi fatto, non ho dubbi che questa giovane promessa avrebbe accettato la sfida comunque.

62.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_066
62.description: But rather than speak on your behalf, mayhap you might share your thoughts on this momentous undertaking?
62.translation_description: Piuttosto che parlare al tuo posto, forse vorresti condividere con noi cosa ne pensi di questa impresa memorabile?

64.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_A7_000_068
64.description: Collecting a load of superfluous knickknacks is what I do best!
64.translation_description: Accumulare una montagna di cianfrusaglie superflue è la mia specialità!

65.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_A7_000_069
65.description: I feel my efforts were amply rewarded.
65.translation_description: Direi che i miei sforzi sono stati ampiamente ricompensati.

66.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_A7_000_070
66.description: I'd rather scrub a behemoth's backside than do that again...
66.translation_description: Preferirei strofinare il didietro di un Behemoth piuttosto che rifarlo...

67.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_071
67.description: Most admirable! And for what it's worth, it was an honor to supply you with said knickknacks.
67.translation_description: Ammirevole! E, per quel che vale, per me è stato un onore rifornirti di simili cianfrusaglie.

68.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_072
68.description: In which case, I can rest assured that the challenge I set was both fair and worthwhile for all involved.
68.translation_description: In tal caso, è rassicurante sapere che la sfida che ho proposto è stata equa e proficua per tutti.

69.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_073
69.description: Well, I daresay it was character-building in some way. After all, a bit of seemingly pointless drudgery never killed anyone. Or at least I don't think it did...
69.translation_description: Be’, direi che è stata una prova formativa, in un certo senso. Dopotutto, un po’ di lavoro noioso e apparentemente inutile non ha mai ucciso nessuno. O almeno... credo.

70.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_074
70.description: In any case, the deed is done, and the time has come for me to bid you farewell. Until our paths next cross, adventurer!
70.translation_description: Comunque sia, il compito è concluso ed è giunto il momento di salutarti. Alla prossima, avventuriero!

71.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_075
71.description: Where might his wandering take him next, I, ah...wonder.
71.translation_description: Mi domando, ah... dove lo porterà la prossima tappa del suo viaggio.

72.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_076
72.description: Like him, you are also not wont to stay in one place overlong. I pray that when next we meet, we might have some new tales to share. Take care, my friend.
72.translation_description: Come lui, anche tu non ami restare a lungo nello stesso luogo. Spero che al nostro prossimo incontro avremo nuove storie da raccontarci. Stammi bene, amico mio.

73.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_A1_000_005
73.translation_description: Acquista il kit per cornice di Yo-kai Watch.

75.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_Q8_000_001
75.translation_description: Acquistare <hex:02310DFF054974656D03F2A345020203> per <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP?<hex:02100103>Al momento ne possiedi <hex:022206E803FF022C03>.

76.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_078
76.description: Unable to obtain <hex:02310DFF054974656D03F2A345020203>. You already have received one.
76.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere <hex:02310DFF054974656D03F2A345020203>: ne hai già ricevuto uno.

77.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_079
77.description: Unable to obtain <hex:02310DFF054974656D03F2A345020203> due to insufficient inventory space or having already obtained the item.
77.translation_description: Impossibile ottenere <hex:02310DFF054974656D03F2A345020203>: spazio insufficiente nell’inventario oppure hai già ottenuto l’oggetto.

78.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_080
78.description: Terribly sorry, but this prize is meant only for those who have befriended each and every Yo-kai. If you wish to earn it, you can start by gathering Yo-kai Medals and growing your circle of companions!
78.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma questo premio è riservato a chi ha stretto amicizia con ogni singolo Yo-kai. Se vuoi ottenerlo, comincia raccogliendo medaglie Yo-kai e ampliando la tua cerchia di compagni!

79.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_HINOSHIN_000_081
79.description: You have proven yourself a loyal friend to Yo-kai of all shapes and sizes, and for that, you deserve this. A singular gift to reward your singular devotion!
79.translation_description: Hai dimostrato tutta la tua lealtà verso gli Yo-kai di ogni forma e dimensione, e per questo meriti questo premio: un dono unico per ricompensare una devozione altrettanto rara!

80.name: TEXT_FESYKWMEDALEXCHANGE_00348_SYSTEM_000_082
80.description: Insufficient MGP. <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP is needed to complete the purchase.
80.translation_description: MGP insufficienti: per completare l’acquisto servono <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP.
